data.body: **[P1] Do not infer legacy envelopes from arbitrary JSON.** A valid initial input or raw callback/standard-invoke result such as `{"data":"value"}` is classified as an inline filesystem envelope, so only `"value"` is passed to the delegate and deserialization fails for the original DTO. A single `file` property can similarly trigger an unintended filesystem read. Require the version marker by default and gate unversioned JavaScript-envelope compatibility behind an explicit mode; add root-input and external-result regression tests.
